label: Auto Kick
description: Automatically kicks players (after a warning) for using words from the word list. Regex patterns can also go in autokick_patterns.txt, and incidents are logged to autokick.log.

commands.name: addword
commands.description: Add a word to the list.

commands.name: delword
commands.description: Remove a word from the list.

cvars.label: Warnings before kick
cvars.description: Number of warnings a player gets before being kicked.

cvars.label: Mode
cvars.description: "kick": warn then kick. "warn": block the message and notify the player, never kick. "silent": block the message without notifying anyone.
